title: Metric
question: How many, and is it going up?
readings: the big number: the value now
the change chip: how much it moved over the period, its sign and its tone (good or bad news, from higherIs)
the curve: the recent series, the last point marked
the hot lines: the few items behind the number that need a look, each one opening its item
strengths: one glance gives the level and the direction
the hot lines lead straight to the items that matter
avoid: when the number only means something against a target: use goal or bullet
when the point is a list of things to process, one gesture each: use queue
when several values compete: use a ranking or a split

unit.description: Written after the value and the change: "%", "k€"

higherIs.description: Whether a rise is good news (sales) or bad news (open returns)

hotCount.description: How many hot lines to show

spark.description: In a domain bar's pill: the series as a sparkline, in the full bar only

action: mode next: open the most urgent of the items behind the number ("Process the 1st")
